important_caveats: The Wikipedia matrix is a compatibility/standardization table, not a guarantee that every player, editor, decoder or hardware device will play every combination.
Some entries represent indirect, private, partial, setup-dependent or non-standard support.
AVI VBR audio limitations can be caused by ACM rather than the AVI container itself.
WebM is a restricted subset of Matroska and intentionally supports a limited codec set.
The page notes that some common multimedia formats are combinations of containers and codec/profile restrictions, such as AVCHD and DivX formats.
The source page itself carries an April 2026 warning about possible original research/synthesis.
